headlines.title: Personalized mRNA vaccine for melanoma cut risk of cancer’s return in late-stage trial
headlines.description: Moderna and Merck’s personalized mRNA vaccine for melanoma reduced the risk of cancer recurrence and death by 42% compared with standard treatment in a trial.

headlines.title: Marshall Faulk, Hall of Fame running back, reveals he has Parkinson’s disease
headlines.description: Hall of Fame running back and Southern University football coach Marshall Faulk revealed that he’s been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease and hopes early detection will give him chances “at living a better quality of life.”

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The Health Metrics to Track for Improved Longevity
headlines.description: Dr. Vonda Wright, orthopedic surgeon and author of "Unbreakable;" joins TODAY's Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to break down why bone, muscle and joints are key indicators of longevity and walks viewers through exercises to test strength and mobility, including the sit-to-stand test and a grip strength test. She also explains why it's important to ask your doctor for a DEXA scan and a fasting glucose and a fasting insulin blood test.

headlines.title: From the Playground to the Gym: Exercise Goals for Every Age
headlines.description: Did you know the kind of exercise you need changes as you get older? NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal joins TODAY with what you need to know, including keeping young kids and teenagers active, the bare minimums for people in their 20s and 30s, how to stay strong for midlife and improving balance in your 60s and beyond.

headlines.title: Flu Season 2026 Arrives Early: What You Need to Know
headlines.description: The 2026 flu season is starting far earlier than expected so NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY with what’s driving the surge, why teenagers are being hit especially hard, and what it signals for the rest of the flu and cold season.

headlines.title: AI model uses facial photos to estimate cancer survival and biological age
headlines.description: Researchers at Mass General Brigham developed AI models trained on 40 million facial images that may predict cancer survival and estimate biological age — but they say the tools aren't ready for clinical use. NBC News artificial intelligence reporter Jared Perlo and NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal explain how it works.

headlines.title: Over 4 million tubes of toothpaste have been recalled, including several kids brands
headlines.description: More than 4.3 million tubes of fluoride toothpaste, including Brush Buddies Hot Wheels, Crayola and My Little Pony, were recalled. Here’s how to check your tubes.

headlines.title: 17+ best deals from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, according to a beauty editor
headlines.description: We rounded up the best deals on skin care, makeup, hair care and more from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, including favorites from Medicube, Tarte, Clinique and more.

headlines.title: How often should you replace your pillows? Here’s what experts say
headlines.description: Experts share how often you should clean pillows and when it’s time to replace them. Plus, how to keep pillows in great shape over time.

headlines.title: The best N95 masks to protect against airborne viruses
headlines.description: NIOSH-approved N95 respirators are the most protective type of face mask, according to the CDC. Doctors explain how to shop for them.

headlines.title: Flu Activity is Ramping Up Early This Year. Is a Mutated H1N1 Strain to Blame?
headlines.description: The 2026-2027 flu season is starting early, fueled by an H1N1 strain with a new mutation. Here’s where flu activity is surging and how to protect yourself.
